title: Immutable resolved simulation plan built from the existing resolvers

fixture.scene: tests/test_plan.py::scene: 2D region 1.6 x 1.5 x 1.4 um, uniform mesh 0.1 um (16 x 15 cells), Yee material sampling, 3 PML cells (x_min: 4 layers, kappa 2, alpha 0.03, alpha_polynomial 1), courant_factor 0.99, 24 steps, one SiN (n = 2) rectangle 0.3 x 0.4 um at (-0.3, 0.1), one continuous Ez point source at (-0.2, 0) with wavelength 1.1 um, either two point monitors (Ez at (0.1, 0), Hy at (0, 0.1)) or one x-normal field monitor 0.65 x 0.55 um at x = 0.12 um with downsample 2
variants: dispersive Drude and two-pole Lorentz materials with a one-way sheet on a periodic 2D cell (3 x 1 um, 0.05 um, 40 steps)
TFSF box of benchmarks/tfsf_sources.box_project with 30 steps
Bloch y axis with phase 0.3 and an Ez sheet

reference_method: the resolvers the solver itself runs: mesh_nodes, field_axes, BoundaryDescription, MaterialADE on a live YeeGrid, source_terms and oneway_tables, source_time_signal, plane_plan, interpolation_map, frequency_samples, voxelize, estimate; equality is exact array equality

observables.name: placement_independence
observables.definition: backend, kernels, memory/execution mode, tiling, precision, display fields, ids, names and colors leave plan_hash unchanged and appear only under placement. in plan.diff

observables.name: array_immutability
observables.definition: every array of the plan and of plan.material has writeable == False; the dataclass rejects attribute assignment

observables.name: resolver_agreement
observables.definition: ADE coefficients, one-way E/H tables, TFSF drive, Bloch wrap phase and sheet profile, PMC endpoint faces, point-monitor indices equal the live resolvers exactly

observables.name: diff_keys
observables.definition: plan.diff names exactly the changed canonical keys for a moved structure, a refined mesh, a changed phase and an inert setting

acceptance.equality: exact: np.testing.assert_array_equal on every compared array, string equality on hashes
acceptance.placement: plan_hash identical across the placement variant; diff restricted to placement.* keys
acceptance.immutability: no writeable array; FrozenInstanceError or TypeError on assignment
acceptance.source_of_limits: exact identities; no numerical threshold from completion_gates.json applies

not_yet_covered: explicit (mesh_coordinates) and axis-step meshes in the CPML profile record

notes: The sampled material enters plan_hash through its rasterization inputs on the hashed nodes; the voxel arrays are materialized on demand (plan.material) so that resolving a plan never allocates a full volume for a streamed scene. The resource estimate is carried but not hashed because it depends on the precision.
